messages:
Noah (Infra): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: a few customers asked whether APAC will support Dedicated pools with burst behavior different from Hosted. Can we clarify?
Aisha (Product): Short answer: Dedicated customers can opt into a higher guaranteed baseline (reserved nodes) to avoid cross-region fallback; Hosted remains more elastic. We'll document options.
Connor (Eng): Technical nuance: autoscaler has two knobs -- rapid_burst and sustained_scale. rapid_burst lets a pool spike up to N extra replicas for T seconds; sustained_scale ramps up more slowly but keeps nodes for longer.
Noah (Infra): Example we use internally:
```
autoscaler:
  rapid_burst:
    extra_replicas: 8
    duration_s: 120
  sustained_scale:
    scale_step: 4
    cool_down_s: 600
```
Connor (Eng): If a customer's Dedicated pool sets reserved_nodes > 0, rapid_burst will still be honored but fallback to other regions is suppressed until both reserved + burst are exhausted.
Aisha (Product): For Hosted, default is no reserved capacity. We may offer an "APAC fast-path" add-on that keeps a small warm pool for customers who want lower latency during pilot. Pricing TBD.
Leila (CEO): Actionable asks for the next week: (1) Noah & Connor draft a short FAQ for Sales about "what happens when APAC runs out of GPUs" (2) Aisha compile pilot customer list and flag which need private/Dedicated (3) Ops-bot: upload recording + slides to thread.
ops-bot: Recording + slides uploaded: https://redwood.slack-recordings/1846234512 :sound: :page_facing_up:
Noah (Infra): I'll also add two monitoring alerts: apac_gpu_pool_util_pct > 85% (warning) and fallback_cross_region_count > 0 (pager). Will PR dashboard by Tue.
Aisha (Product): Thanks! Sales/SEs: if you have customers in the APAC pilot, drop their name + contact in the shared sheet. We'll prioritize private deploys first.
Leila (CEO): Let's keep this tight — we want pilot feedback before end of quarter. Small team meets tomorrow 9am PT to confirm PO timeline and test plan.
Connor (Eng): Note on latency: cross-region fallback adds ~70-120ms median and can spike more under load. We'll include this in the FAQ.
Noah (Infra): Closing out: I'll post the draft FAQ and the dashboard link here when ready. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
file_notes: Follow-up Q&A from all-hands focusing on Dedicated vs Hosted autoscaler behavior for APAC rollout, includes example autoscaler config snippet, monitoring/alert plans, and concrete action items.
